short.en: The route counter behind a gate

t.zh: 这段楼梯有几级坏了，踩不得，画成石头的样子。每次还是迈 1 级或 2 级。
t.en: A few steps on this staircase are broken and can’t be stepped on; they are drawn like rocks. Each stride still goes up 1 or 2 steps.

goal.zh: 每次迈 1 级或 2 级，不能踩在坏台阶上。算出爬到最上面一级有几种走法。
goal.en: Each stride goes up 1 or 2 steps, never onto a broken step. Work out how many ways there are to reach the top step.

how.zh: 从地面一级一级往上算。
how.en: Work up from the ground, one step at a time.

say.zh: 有的台阶坏了，踩不得。读一读「是坏台阶」。
say.en: Some steps are broken and can’t be stepped on. Read “is broken”.

hints.zh: 元件箱里的<part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>也会数走法：前 1 级、前 2 级就是它的两条来路，是地面就是它的起点。
hints.en: The <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref> in your components box counts ways too: 1 step down and 2 steps down are its two ways in, and the ground is its start.

hints.zh: 坏台阶上要掐断：拦截闸在条件是「是」时输出「—」。
hints.en: Cut off the broken steps: a Block gate outputs “—” when its condition is “yes”.

body.zh: 坏台阶上是「—」。上面的台阶加起来时跳过它，经过它的走法自然就不算了。
body.en: A broken step holds “—”. The steps above skip it when they add up, so the ways through it simply drop out.

body.zh: <level-ref to="rocks"></level-ref>在棋盘城市里做过同一件事：零件只认结构，不认是路口还是台阶。
body.en: <level-ref to="rocks"></level-ref> did the same thing in the grid city: parts care about structure, not whether they count crossings or steps.
